title: PCBA Test Engineer
locations: Maynard, Massachusetts, United States of America
teaser: Become part of our team as a PCBA Test Engineer, contributing to the deployment of manufacturing test strategies for optical transceiver subassemblies. You will develop and optimise test solutions, collaborate with engineering teams, and troubleshoot hardware issues. Ideal candidates bring relevant manufacturing experience and expertise in PCBA assemblies and test automation.
description:
This role will be onsite in our Maynard, MA office

  

Meet the Team 

Our team creates manufacturing test solutions for cutting-edge Optical Transceiver products.  We are at the very crossroads between Engineering development, Program Management, and Contract Manufacturing and thus in a unique position to influence cross-functional strategy through our expertise and innovation.  We’re a high-performance team with high visibility, high expectations, and an excellent track record of successes.

Your Impact 

Drawing from your industry experience, you'll be an essential member of the Operations Test Engineering organization and a key contributor in the deployment of manufacturing test strategies for optical transceiver subassemblies.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Own end-to-end development and deployment of test solutions for PCBA subassembly hardware from initial fixturing to formal handoff to sustaining team and contract manufacturer.

Collaborate closely with Hardware and Mechanical Engineering teams to identify and resolve design issues related to product and evaluation hardware.

Use LabVIEW and Python to create and optimize automated test scripts to support test automation.

Participate in regression testing of product firmware, and evaluation host software validation.

Troubleshoot product sub-assemblies, evaluation boards, thermal fixtures, and process fixtures to ensure readiness for new product platforms.

Generate test instructions and fixturing concepts; train contract manufacturing team during product deployment and debug.

Minimum Qualifications 

2 or 4-year technology degree in Electronics, Engineering Technology, or other relevant focus area.

At least two years of relevant manufacturing industry experience

Experience in troubleshooting PCBA assemblies, as well as thermal and mechanical fixturing

Familiarity with rack-mounted test equipment including communication protocols for automated control such as I2C and SPI

Experience with standard debugging equipment such as DVM’s and Oscilloscopes.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or related major.

Experience in high volume offshore manufacturing with focus in Optics, RF and\or electronic testing

Familiarity with revision control platforms and systems such as Agile or Omnify.

In-depth knowledge of manufacturing workflows, GR&R, SPC, and process control-related statistical analysis

Experience with test, deployment, and troubleshooting of manufacturing evaluation platforms

Python or LabVIEW proficiency

Fixture design experience using SolidWorks
